name: Doki Doki A Brand New Day
storyline: Sayori has forced our protagonist to join the Literature Club. However, he still has a feeling of déjà vu. He soon discovers the girls' secret problems and, like the helpful person he is, heroically saves them from whatever problems they have. They are very grateful and he wins the affection of all the girls! That's not all in this story. There's something even bigger going on behind the scenes that could cost them their lives! Can he really save them? Find out in A Brand New Day!
summary: Doki Doki: A Brand New Day is a mod for Doki Doki Literature Club! that revamps the original game experience, offering a new perspective on the story and allowing the player to change the fate of the characters. In this mod, the protagonist is aware of the traumatic events of the base game and seeks to prevent the tragedies from occurring. This leads to a storyline full of new interactions, choices and exciting moments, giving players the chance to create a different future for Sayori, Yuri, Natsuki and Monika.
